description: This file defines an Angular component called 'EditorComponent' which provides a text editing interface for notes, handling input changes, auto-resizing of text areas, and emitting change events to parent components.

classes.name: EditorComponent
classes.description: An Angular standalone component for editing notes with auto-resize capabilities, handling input changes and emitting updates.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that updates the editor content when the input note changes and schedules auto-resizing.

methods.name: onFieldChange
methods.description: Handles user input changes, emits updated note data to parent, and triggers auto-resize.

methods.name: autoResize
methods.description: Automatically adjusts the height of the textarea to fit its content.
